name: Shellock Holmes

abilities.name: Naturalist
abilities.text: Immune to Pollen. Starts the game with one Bonus Card

abilities.name: Informant Network
abilities.text: Can attack either Grub from any location

abilities.name: Plots & Ploys
abilities.text: Can use your Grub Cards' hearts to mitigate damage. Discard Grub when fully damaged. Can no longer use the effects of injured Grubs

flavorQuote: It is my business to know what other people do not know

name: Beowing

abilities.name: Stargazer
abilities.text: Immune to Nighttime. Starts the game with one Bonus Card

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.text: Any teammate die rolled nearby is +1. Any Predator die rolled nearby is -1

abilities.name: Berseker
abilities.text: Whenever you take damage, roll. 3-5 heals 1 heart, 6 heals 2 hearts

flavorQuote: I swim in the blackness of night, hunting enemies out in the wilderness... defeat is my errand and the fate they have earned

name: Wyatt Chirp

abilities.name: Hardtack
abilities.text: Starts the game with 1 food

abilities.name: Payback
abilities.text: When you miss a production roll, gain a free meal

abilities.name: Thick Feathers
abilities.text: All predator return attacks are -1 damage

flavorQuote: You gonna do something', or just stand there and cry?

name: Madam Chickovsky

abilities.name: Cold-Hardy
abilities.text: Experiences no negative effects from Freezing Temperatures or Hail

abilities.name: Ladies' Aid
abilities.text: Once per turn you may give away 1 food to a nearby player, if you do, heal 1 heart

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.text: Can perform all actions Outside

flavorQuote: Life is beautiful in spite of everything! There are many thorns, but roses are there too

name: Cluckleberry Finn

abilities.name: Endowment
abilities.text: Start the game with one egg

abilities.name: Quite Friendly
abilities.text: Can take one nearby player into combat with you. The other player attacks second.

abilities.name: Superior Product
abilities.text: Your eggs are worth 2x food during the Egg Exchange

flavorQuote: The average chicken don't like trouble and danger, but I ain't average

name: Eggatha Christie

abilities.name: Warm-Hardy
abilities.text: Starts the game with one egg. Immune to Drough and Extreme Heat

abilities.name: The Forager
abilities.text: When Foraging, roll. If 3-6, collect 2 food instead of 1

abilities.name: Tomb Raider
abilities.text: Once per turn, you may attack a discarded grub. Once a revived grub has been used, remove it from the game

flavorQuote: You cannot go on indefinitely being just an ordinary, decent egg. We must be hatched or go bad

name: Cumberbill Rockefeather

abilities.name: Long Legs
abilities.text: Starts the game with one egg. Immune to Pouring Rain

abilities.name: Landlord
abilities.text: Can move Inside for free

abilities.name: Dandy
abilities.text: Immune to negative weather

flavorQuote: Always turn every disaster into an opportunity

name: Annie Yolkley

abilities.name: Endowment
abilities.text: Starts the game with one egg

abilities.name: Bacaw!
abilities.text: Lay an egg on the game board wherever you take damage. The egg may be collected by any player in that location

abilities.name: High Producer
abilities.text: Roll twice for egg during your Production Roll.

flavorQuote: Words and eggs must be handled with care. Once broken, they are impossible things to repair.

name: General Tso

abilities.name: Traveler
abilities.text: You may start the game Outside. Starts the game with one egg

abilities.name: Foresight
abilities.text: When taking the Draw Card action, you may draw 2 Bonus Cards. Keep 1 and discard the other

abilities.name: Strategem
abilities.text: For every egg you discard, you may adjust the roll of any die by 1

flavorQuote: If you fight with all your might, there is a chance of life; whereas death is certain if you cling to your Coop

name: Wingston Coophill

abilities.name: Misdirection
abilities.text: Can discard 2 Bonus Cards to halve the amount of damage taken (rounding down)

abilities.name: Smallest Chicken
abilities.text: When a nearby player leaves your location, you may tag along and go with them

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.text: When attacking, roll. If 3-6, Dodge Predator return attack (and effects).

flavorQuote: He will defend our Coop whatever the cost may be. We shall fight in the fields; we shall fight in the forests. We shall never surrender.

name: Atilla the Hen

abilities.name: Big-Boned
abilities.text: Experiences no negative effects from Tornadoes. Starts the game with 2 food

abilities.name: Tank
abilities.text: You may take some or all damage for other nearby players

abilities.name: Just Reward
abilities.text: Whenever you take damage for another player, gain 2 eggs

flavorQuote: Every day's a lovely day for a group of friends to trample enemies underfoot

name: Princess Layer

abilities.name: Nobility
abilities.text: Can pay eggs to refresh your Extra Action Token. Starts with one egg

abilities.name: Well-Laid Plans
abilities.text: When taking the Lay Egg action (not production), roll. If 3-6 collect 2 eggs, instead of 1

abilities.name: Eggpire Strikes Back
abilities.text: Can discard Eggs to mitigate DMG to yourself (1 Egg: 1 Heart)

flavorQuote: Aren't you a little short fora  storm cooper?

name: Chickira

abilities.name: Endowment
abilities.text: Starts the game with one egg

abilities.name: Wherever, any Weather
abilities.text: Free actino: Once per turn, you may roll. If 4-6, Draw a new Weather Card from the appropriate deck. Shuffle if needed.

abilities.name: Shake it Off
abilities.text: If you miss your Production Roll, heal 1 heart

flavorQuote: Life is a corn field, don't you think

name: Broods Lee

abilities.name: Revenge
abilities.text: Draw a Bonus Card if you are present when a Predator is defeated

abilities.name: Adrenaline
abilities.text: Max attack strength is +1 if not at full health. (Still pay food cost)

abilities.name: Bolsterer
abilities.text: Max Strength of nearby players is +1 if they are not at full health

flavorQuote: Mistakes are always forgivable if one has the courage to admit them

name: J.R.R. Yolkien

abilities.name: Bookworm
abilities.text: Has a Bonus Card hand limit of 3. Cannot take damage from Grubs

abilities.name: Dedication
abilities.text: Whenever you take the same action twice on your turn, lay an egg on your space. This egg may be collected by any plater in that location at any time.

abilities.name: Deus Eggs Machina
abilities.text: Immune to Fog. Can pay one egg to re-roll any die (Once per occasion)

flavorQuote: I do not love the beak for it's sharpness nor the wing for its swiftness. I love only that which they defend.

name: Cluck Norris

abilities.name: Not really a miss
abilities.text: If you miss an attack, draw a Bonus Card. If a nearby teammate misses an attack, gain one food

abilities.name: Always on Purpose
abilities.text: Free Action. Oce per turn, you may take 1 DMG to gain 2 eggs

abilities.name: Quick Claws
abilities.text: Free action: Once per turn you may pay an egg to draw a Bonus Card

flavorQuote: I can kill two stones with one bird

name: Aracorn, Heir of Condor

abilities.name: Free Range
abilities.text: You may start the game outside. Everyone in your location is immune to Bird Flu

abilities.name: Long Shanks
abilities.text: Free action: Once per turn, you may move between Outside locations for free.

abilities.name: Wilderness Guide
abilities.text: Immune to Severe Wind. Free action: Once per turn, you may pay an egg to move another player

flavorQuote: The beacons are lit! Condor calls for aid! And Rohen will answer!
